title: Ruby Trade World
description: Rubi Trade World is a lightweight Minecraft Fabric modpack centered around a custom Ruby Coin economy. Replace traditional emerald trading with a new balanced currency system, explore enhanced villager trading, and experience a redesigned survival economy
body: Rubi Trade World is a lightweight Minecraft Fabric modpack centered around a custom Ruby Coin economy. Replace traditional emerald trading with a new balanced currency system, explore enhanced villager trading, and experience a redesigned survival economy with custom tools, weapons, and trading mechanics. Perfect for players who want a fresh and upgraded vanilla+ experience.A Vanilla+ economy modpack powered by Ruby Coins instead of Emeralds.Build, trade, and survive in a world where Ruby Coins replace emeralds and every villager trade is rebalanced for a fresh economy experience.
